record.question: Which of the following statements is true regarding fluid loss?
options: Substantial evaporative losses can be associated with large wounds and are directly proportionate to the surface area exposed
Internal redistribution of fluids, "third spacing," cannot cause massive fluid shifts
Traumatized, inflamed, or infected tissues can only sequester minimal amounts of fluid in the interstitial space
Cellular dysfunction as a result of hypoxia usually produces a decrease in intracellular fluid volume
